scenarios.summary: Return the guest to its ordinary state: network on, no shaping, default appearance and accessibility settings, no scenario environment.
scenarios.script:
nmcli networking on >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
sudo tc qdisc del dev enp0s1 root >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
gsettings reset org.gnome.desktop.interface text-scaling-factor || true
gsettings reset org.gnome.desktop.interface enable-animations || true
gsettings reset org.gnome.desktop.interface color-scheme || true
gsettings reset org.gnome.desktop.a11y.interface high-contrast || true
gsettings reset org.gnome.desktop.a11y.applications screen-keyboard-enabled || true
rm -f "$HOME/.local/share/luma-emulator/scenario.env"
echo 'guest returned to normal'

scenarios.summary: Disconnect the guest from every network through NetworkManager, exactly as a user losing connectivity would.
scenarios.script:
nmcli networking off
sleep 1
nmcli -t -f STATE general

scenarios.summary: Apply 400 ms latency, 120 ms jitter and 8% loss to the guest interface using the kernel's own traffic control.
scenarios.script:
iface=$(ip -o -4 route show default | awk '{print $5}' | head -1)
test -n "$iface" || { echo 'no default route in the guest' >&2; exit 1; }
sudo tc qdisc replace dev "$iface" root netem delay 400ms 120ms loss 8%
tc qdisc show dev "$iface"

scenarios.summary: Publish one incoming-message notification through the freedesktop notification service the shell actually listens to.
scenarios.script: gdbus call --session --dest org.freedesktop.Notifications --object-path /org/freedesktop/Notifications --method org.freedesktop.Notifications.Notify 'Messages' 0 'org.projectluma.Messages' 'Avery Chen' 'Are we still on for tomorrow?' '[]' '{}' 8000

scenarios.summary: Publish four notifications in sequence so stacking, grouping and overflow presentation can be inspected.
scenarios.script:
set -e
notify() { gdbus call --session --dest org.freedesktop.Notifications --object-path /org/freedesktop/Notifications --method org.freedesktop.Notifications.Notify "$1" 0 "$2" "$3" "$4" '[]' '{}' 12000 >/dev/null; }
notify Messages org.projectluma.Messages 'Avery Chen' 'Are we still on for tomorrow?'
notify Messages org.projectluma.Messages 'Rowan Patel' 'Sent the file over.'
notify Calendar org.projectluma.Calendar 'Design review' 'Starts in 10 minutes'
notify Tasks org.projectluma.Tasks 'Water the plants' 'Due today'
echo 'four notifications published'

scenarios.summary: Publish one calendar reminder notification.
scenarios.script: gdbus call --session --dest org.freedesktop.Notifications --object-path /org/freedesktop/Notifications --method org.freedesktop.Notifications.Notify 'Calendar' 0 'org.projectluma.Calendar' 'Design review' 'Starts in 10 minutes, Studio 2' '[]' '{}' 10000

scenarios.summary: Raise the interface text scaling factor to 1.5 through the desktop settings schema; running applications follow immediately.
scenarios.script:
gsettings set org.gnome.desktop.interface text-scaling-factor 1.5
gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.interface text-scaling-factor

scenarios.summary: Turn on the accessibility high-contrast preference.
scenarios.script:
gsettings set org.gnome.desktop.a11y.interface high-contrast true
gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.a11y.interface high-contrast

scenarios.summary: Disable animations. Luma's AppKit motion_duration() reads the same toolkit preference, so component transitions collapse to zero.
scenarios.script:
gsettings set org.gnome.desktop.interface enable-animations false
gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.interface enable-animations

scenarios.summary: Ask for the dark appearance through the desktop colour-scheme preference.
scenarios.script:
gsettings set org.gnome.desktop.interface color-scheme 'prefer-dark'
gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.interface color-scheme

scenarios.summary: Ask for the light appearance through the desktop colour-scheme preference.
scenarios.script:
gsettings set org.gnome.desktop.interface color-scheme 'prefer-light'
gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.interface color-scheme

scenarios.summary: Enable the on-screen keyboard preference the handheld shell uses to raise the software keyboard.
scenarios.script:
gsettings set org.gnome.desktop.a11y.applications screen-keyboard-enabled true
gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.a11y.applications screen-keyboard-enabled

scenarios.summary: Launch subsequent previews in a right-to-left locale. Applies to previews started after the scenario, because text direction is fixed at application start.
scenarios.interface: POSIX locale, honoured by GTK text direction
scenarios.script:
mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/share/luma-emulator"
printf 'export LANG=ar_EG.UTF-8
export LC_ALL=ar_EG.UTF-8
export LANGUAGE=ar
' > "$HOME/.local/share/luma-emulator/scenario.env"
echo 'right-to-left locale armed for the next preview launch'

scenarios.summary: Launch subsequent previews in a locale with long translated strings, to expose truncation and wrapping.
scenarios.script:
mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/share/luma-emulator"
printf 'export LANG=de_DE.UTF-8
export LC_ALL=de_DE.UTF-8
export LANGUAGE=de
' > "$HOME/.local/share/luma-emulator/scenario.env"
echo 'long-string locale armed for the next preview launch'

scenarios.summary: Rotate the handheld output to landscape through the compositor's own output management.
scenarios.script:
command -v wlr-randr >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'wlr-randr is only meaningful in a wlroots (handheld) session' >&2; exit 1; }
output=$(wlr-randr | head -1 | awk '{print $1}')
wlr-randr --output "$output" --transform 90
wlr-randr | head -3

scenarios.summary: Return the handheld output to portrait.
scenarios.script:
command -v wlr-randr >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'wlr-randr is only meaningful in a wlroots (handheld) session' >&2; exit 1; }
output=$(wlr-randr | head -1 | awk '{print $1}')
wlr-randr --output "$output" --transform normal
wlr-randr | head -3

scenarios.summary: Present the shell and applications with a nearly empty battery.
scenarios.gap: UPower exposes no supported injection point. Doing this honestly needs a development-only umockdev power-supply adapter outside the production packages; it is not built yet.

scenarios.summary: Present the shell and applications with a charging battery.
Ring an incoming call through the real telephony path.
scenarios.gap: There is no modem in the guest and no development call adapter on the Prairie Phone daemon's D-Bus surface yet. A notification would look convincing and prove nothing, so it is not offered.

scenarios.summary: Show a missed call.
Show an in-progress call with call audio routing.
scenarios.gap: Same telephony gap as incoming-call, and call audio routing is a physical-device claim the emulator cannot make.

scenarios.summary: Show each application with no user content.
scenarios.gap: Needs development-only fixtures behind each app's own backend module. The emulator will not reach into application storage directly.

scenarios.summary: Hold each application in its loading state.
scenarios.gap: Same per-application adapter gap as empty-state.

scenarios.summary: Make a backing service fail so error presentation can be inspected.
scenarios.gap: Same per-application adapter gap as empty-state.
